comment: The benchmark runs the live check (scripts/live-check/check.ts) on each implementation it compares, then a stress stage that pushes as fast as the implementation's pace allows until Airbnb rate-limits it, and measures both from the client's trace. An implementation completes when its live check passes and its stress stage does not end Blocked; rate limits it waits out are expected. The bar: complete on every runner, no more hard refusals (403, 428, challenge) than the base, and at least minSpeedRatio of the base's speed. Measured settings, not guesses about Airbnb's limit.
